## Why it happens

The device is not connected to the gateway: its connector is stopped or disabled, or the device has not sent its first value yet. The gateway waits 5 seconds by default, longer when the request sets `timeout` (at most 60 seconds).

## Fix it

Start the connector and wait until the device sends a value. Then write again.

## Check that it worked

The write returns a result and the PLC shows the new value.
